attchmntText: MBL Infrastructure Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: MBL Infrastructure Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a board meeting on November 12, 2026. The standalone profit before tax was Rs. 2,934 lakhs for the six months ended September 30, 2026, compared to Rs. 628 lakhs in the previous year. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 0.25 for the period. The auditor's report highlights the finality of the resolution plan approved under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. It notes an increase in paid-up equity share capital to 215,588 lakhs following the allotment of 33,50,000 equity shares. The report also addresses investments in subsidiaries MBL MP Road Nirman Company Limited, MBL Projects Limited, MBL Highway Development Company Limited, and Suratgarh Bikaner Toll Road Company Private Limited, stating management considers these recoverable. Claims regarding project delays and cancellations are under negotiation or litigation.
